issue.body:
Shouldn't the default return code on authentication failure be a 401 instead of a 400? https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/78f7095d7e254940fe242e72055f3d0d7883b405/starlette/middleware/authentication.py#L52

Unless this is because you cannot know what to send back in WWW-Authenticate header ?
issue.title: Return 401 on authentication error
